blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The number of focus crimes recorded by the Philippine National Police fell by 36.05% in September from the same month last year, police said Monday. The PNP recorded 2,063 cases in September, down from 3,226 in September 2025. “We welcome this improvement, but we are not letting our guard down,” PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. said at a press briefing.
